public.title: Conforms To
public.description: Each rule is {key,op,value}; op is equal or atLeast. Return true only if row owns every key and its value satisfies strict scalar equality or numeric atLeast. Rules compare integers or strings; atLeast values and matching fields are integers. Empty rules succeeds. Supported inputs contain at most 100 array entries per sequence and at most 20 operations or requests per sequence, at most 60 total object properties and array elements in any single JSON value, nesting depth at most 8, strings at most 100 ASCII characters unless specified otherwise, and integers from -100 through 100 unless a tighter or explicit alternate bound is stated. The entire argument JSON encoding is at most 1000 bytes. Nested sequences collectively have at most 100 entries; output snapshots therefore remain bounded. Inputs always satisfy the described shape and bounds.
hints: Every rule must succeed; a missing own key always fails.
Check the public examples against the documented empty-input and boundary rules.

explanation: Use conjunction across predicates with the correct inclusive numeric comparison. O(rule count) time and O(1) auxiliary space. This JSON adapter verifies observable results; it does not establish built-in-method restrictions, garbage collection, browser behavior or real timer/microtask scheduling.
